# Vendored MathJax

This directory contains the browser component needed to render the site's TeX notation without relying on a third-party CDN.

- Package: `mathjax`
- Version: `4.1.3`
- Component: `tex-chtml.js`
- Source: <https://www.npmjs.com/package/mathjax/v/4.1.3>
- License: Apache-2.0, reproduced in `LICENSE`
- `tex-chtml.js` SHA-256: `6ecd14970a73fca8bb115f8d6967aef818135dee0091339061c41ada230072b6`

The `input/tex/extensions` directory is retained because MathJax can load supported TeX extensions on demand. The matching `mathjax-newcm` CommonHTML font assets are stored in `assets/vendor/mathjax-newcm-font`.
